title: 第11章 柳寞第12章 海重安
lines: 从别墅出来，江来很快返回到停靠在路边的面包车旁。坐上驾驶座，他发动引擎正准备离开。这时，身上的手机铃声突然响了起来。他掏出手机，扫了眼来电号码，随手接通电话，喂了一声。
“是我。”
听到那粗犷而熟悉的声音，江来微微一笑，问道：“你在哪？”
“QZ市。”
“三十分钟后，南月集团外的马路见。”说完。江来挂断了电话，然后驾驶着面包车往目的地赶去。他初来QZ市，对环境还不太熟悉，不清楚有哪些地标性的建筑，相较之下，南月集团在QZ市很出名，比较容易找到。
半小时后，当江来驱车来到南月集团外时，只见一名身材魁梧的中年男子已经在马路旁等候。停好车，他慢慢走向对方。到了近前，中年男子作势便要跪下去，江来连忙制止他的举动，说道：“在外面就不用这么多礼节了，更何况，我已经不是国王了。”
中年男子沉声道：“在我的眼中，只有您才是真正的国王，安德鲁不过是个篡位的叛徒，迟早有一天，我会杀了他，用他的鲜血来祭奠死去的兄弟。”
“这件事情我会亲自去做，不用你插手。”顿了顿，江来话锋一转，问道：“圣殿那边的情况怎么样？”
“安德鲁刚刚上位，下面还有很多兄弟不服，他现在正忙着收拢人心，稳定局面，再加上前几天的行动失败，估计他一时半会腾不出手来找你麻烦。”
“也好，总算给我点喘息的机会。”
中年男子问道：“陛下，我们什么时候杀回去？”
江来沉吟了片刻，缓缓道：“先不着急，单凭你我两个人还不足以对安德鲁构成威胁。更何况，我现在还有更重要的事情要做。”
“您是指卿曼容？”
“不错！比起安德鲁的篡位，我更痛恨她的背叛，如果不找到她，我没心情去做别的事情。不过，她隐藏得太深，要把她找出来并不容易，好在我已经掌握了一些线索，只是需要大量的时间。”说到这，江来看着中年男子，开口道：“柳寞，你是我手下四大天王中唯一幸存的兄弟，也只有你还愿意追随我。”
“陛下，我这条命是你给的，无论如何，我都不会背叛你！”
“我相信你！”话落，江来昂首挺胸，望着漆黑如墨的夜空，深邃的瞳仁中突然迸射出一道冷冽的精光，“柳寞，你知道圣殿历代国王为何只在国外称王，却从不敢在华夏称帝吗？”
柳寞摇了摇头。

“我出身国外，父母都是华裔，很少回国，但我小的时候，爷爷经常跟我说，华夏是东方的神秘古国，有着不可思议的力量。在这个国家，藏龙卧虎，强者辈出，所以圣殿一直不敢染指。当初，我的导师，圣殿的上任国王为了扩张势力，派出大量圣殿精英前往华夏，结果损失惨重，连他也身受重伤，没能多活几年。在他临死前曾跟我说，真正的强者不该满足于现状，应该努力寻求更高的突破。如果有机会，他希望我去华国历练一番，只有在这里，才能深刻体会什么叫做人外有人，天外有天。”
“陛下，那你……”
江来做了个手势，打断柳寞的话语，接腔道：“既然来了华国，不妨见识下真正的强者，开阔下眼界。另外，圣殿的势力你我心知肚明，一旦安德鲁整合完圣殿，将是铁桶一块，难以攻破。所以，我们必须重新建立属于自己的势力，只有这样，才有机会跟安德鲁一较高下。”
“我明白了！”柳寞颔首道：“陛下尽管吩咐，我一定会全力支持您。”
“你先在QZ市找个落脚点，有事我会联系你，另外，你帮我把那辆面包车里的人安顿下，等他没了利用价值，再找地方把他处理掉。”
“是。”柳寞应了一声，立刻走向面包车，带着车内的齐斌驾车离去。
看着渐渐消失在视线中的面包车，江来背负着双手，俊朗的面庞上流露出与年龄不符的坚定和沉稳。
“历代圣殿国王只敢在国外称王，却不敢在华夏称帝……”回想起这句话，他嘴角微扬，笑意淡淡。历代国王都做不到的事情，他很想尝试一下，不然的话，没有挑战的人生岂不是太无趣。
回到叶芙渠家，已是午夜时分。
江来原以为叶芙渠早睡了，没想到她还坐在客厅等着自己，在昏黄的吊灯下，一边看着电视，一边哈欠连连。
“你怎么还不去睡？”
“你都没回来，我哪敢去睡，万一你有事找我，又闯进我卧室怎么办？”
听到这怨气十足的话，江来不由失笑，都说女人是容易记仇的动物，果然不假。
“齐斌呢？”
“放心吧，他不会再来骚扰你了，更不会出现在你的眼前。”
叶芙渠松了口气，起身道：“我给你准备了宵夜，洗澡水也放好了。另外，你的卧室也收拾好了，在我隔壁，要是没有别的事，那我先去休息了，明天有家新的经纪公司约我过去谈谈。”
看着卧室门关上，里面响起房门反锁的声音，江来笑着摇了摇头。那天收拾齐斌的时候，他只是随口一说，开开玩笑，没想到叶芙渠还真做起了端茶倒水，洗衣做饭的事情。
反正自己要在QZ市呆上很长一段时间，有个免费的地方住，还有专人伺候，总比住酒店好。
次日。
当江来睡醒的时候，已经是上午九点多钟了。
他揉着惺忪的睡眼，穿着一条大裤衩走出卧室，只见餐桌上摆放着一个盘子，有煎鸡蛋和烤面包，旁边还有一杯泡好的牛奶。牛奶杯的下面压着一张纸条，上面写着‘我中午不回来了，午饭已经做好放在冰箱，你自己用微波炉热一下。’
虽然早餐有点凉了，但江来并不介意，有个擅长做饭的女人伺候就是好。
吃过早饭，他点燃一根香烟，想着今天该做些什么。这时，门外突然传来一阵‘咚咚咚’的敲门声。
content_en:
After coming out of the villa, Jiang Lai quickly returned to the van parked on the roadside. Sitting in the driver's seat, he started the engine and was about to leave. At this time, the ringtone of the mobile phone on his body suddenly rang. He took out his cell phone, glanced at the caller's number, picked up the call, and said hello.
"It's me."
Hearing that rough and familiar voice, Jiang Lai smiled slightly and asked, "Where are you?"
"QZ City."
"Meet you on the street outside Nanyue Group in thirty minutes." He finished. Jiang Lai hung up the phone and drove the van to his destination. He came to QZ City for the first time and was not very familiar with the environment and didn't know what landmark buildings there were. In comparison, Nanyue Group was well-known in QZ City and was easier to find.
Half an hour later, when Jiang Lai drove outside Nanyue Group, he saw a burly middle-aged man already waiting by the road. After parking the car, he slowly walked towards the other party. When they got closer, the middle-aged man made a gesture to kneel down. Jiang Lai quickly stopped him and said, "There is no need for so many etiquettes outside. What's more, I am no longer the king."
The middle-aged man said solemnly: "In my eyes, only you are the real king. Andrew is just a traitor who usurped the throne. Sooner or later, I will kill him and use his blood to pay tribute to my dead brother."
"I will do this myself, without your intervention." After a pause, Jiang Lai changed the topic and asked, "How is the situation at the temple?"
"Andrew has just taken over, and there are still many brothers below who are dissatisfied. He is now busy winning people's support and stabilizing the situation. Coupled with the failure of the operation in the past few days, it is estimated that he will not be able to spare any time to trouble you."
"Okay, finally give me a chance to breathe."
The middle-aged man asked: "Your Majesty, when will we fight back?"
Jiang Lai pondered for a moment and said slowly: "Don't worry, you and I alone are not enough to pose a threat to Andrew. What's more, I have more important things to do now."
"You mean Qing Manrong?"
"That's right! I hate her betrayal more than Andrew's usurpation. If I don't find her, I'm not in the mood to do anything else. However, she is hidden too deeply, and it is not easy to find her. Fortunately, I have some clues, but it will take a lot of time." Having said this, Jiang Lai looked at the middle-aged man and said, "Liu Lone, you are the only surviving brother among the four kings under me, and you are the only one who is still willing to follow me."
"Your Majesty, you gave me this life. No matter what, I will never betray you!"
"I believe you!" After saying that, Jiang Lai held his head high and looked at the dark night sky. A cold light suddenly burst out from his deep pupils, "Liu Mo, do you know why the kings of the temple only proclaimed themselves kings abroad, but never dared to proclaim themselves emperors in China?"
Liu Mo shook his head.
"I was born abroad, my parents are Chinese, and I rarely return to China. But when I was young, my grandfather often told me that China is a mysterious ancient country in the East with incredible power. In this country, there are hidden dragons and tigers, and strong men emerge in large numbers, so the Temple has never dared to get involved. At the beginning, my mentor, the previous king of the Temple, sent a large number of Saints to expand his power. The elite of the palace went to China, but suffered heavy losses. Even he was seriously injured and did not live for a few more years. Before he died, he told me that a truly strong man should not be satisfied with the status quo and should strive to seek higher breakthroughs. Only here can I deeply understand what it means to have someone outside the world. "
"Your Majesty, then you..."
Jiang Lai made a gesture, interrupted Liu Mo's words, and continued: "Since you have come to China, you might as well meet the real strong men and broaden your horizons. In addition, you and I know the power of the temple. Once Andrew completes the integration of the temple, it will be an iron barrel and difficult to break. Therefore, we must re-establish our own power. Only in this way can we have a chance to compete with Andrew."
"I understand!" Liu Mo nodded and said, "No matter what your Majesty orders, I will definitely support you with all my strength."
"You first find a place to stay in QZ City. I will contact you if anything happens. In addition, you help me settle the person in the van. When he has no use value, I will find a place to dispose of him."
"Yes." Liu Mo responded, immediately walked to the van, and drove away with Qi Bin in the car.
Looking at the van that gradually disappeared from sight, Jiang Lai put his hands behind his back, his handsome face showing determination and composure that belied his age.
"The temple kings of all dynasties only dared to proclaim themselves kings abroad, but they did not dare to proclaim themselves emperors in China..." Recalling this sentence, the corners of his mouth raised slightly with a faint smile. He wanted to try something that kings of all generations could not do. Otherwise, life without challenges would be too boring.
…
It was already midnight when we returned to Ye Fuqu's house.
Jiang Lai originally thought that Ye Fuqu had gone to bed early, but he didn't expect that she was still sitting in the living room waiting for him, watching TV under the dim chandelier and yawning repeatedly.
"Why don't you go to bed yet?"
"You haven't come back yet. How dare I go to sleep? What if you come to me for something and break into my bedroom again?"
Hearing these resentful words, Jiang Lai couldn't help but laugh. They said that women are animals that easily hold grudges, and it was indeed true.
"Where's Qi Bin?"
"Don't worry, he won't harass you again, let alone appear in front of you."
Ye Fuqu breathed a sigh of relief, stood up and said, "I've prepared a midnight snack for you and put away the bath water. In addition, your bedroom has been tidied up. It's next door to mine. If there's nothing else, I'll go and have a rest first. A new brokerage company will ask me to come over tomorrow to talk."
Seeing the bedroom door close and the sound of the door being locked, Jiang Lai smiled and shook his head. When he was cleaning up Qi Bin that day, he just said it casually and joked. Unexpectedly, Ye Fuqu actually started to serve tea and water, wash and cook.
Anyway, I have to stay in QZ City for a long time. It is better to have a free place to stay and have someone to take care of me than staying in a hotel.
The next day.
When Jiang Lai woke up, it was already past nine o'clock in the morning.
He rubbed his sleepy eyes and walked out of the bedroom wearing a pair of big pants. He saw a plate on the dining table with fried eggs and toast, and a glass of soaked milk next to it. There was a note underneath the milk cup that said, 'I won't be back at noon. Lunch has been prepared and put in the refrigerator. You can heat it up in the microwave. ’
Although the breakfast was a bit cold, Jiang Lai didn't mind. It would be nice to have a woman who is good at cooking to serve him.
After breakfast, he lit a cigarette and thought about what he should do today. At this time, there was a sudden knock on the door.
title_en: Chapter 11 Liu Loneliness Chapter 12 Hai Chongan
